title: Changing Client Secret for Azure Application

blocks.text: You can update the client secret for the application you created while onboarding an Azure subscription. The client secret ID in Microsoft Azure is a confidential string that is used as a password for the application. It comes with an expiration date and must be renewed for the application to retain DSPM's access.
Make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: You must be assigned either an Administrator role or any role with Change Application Details permissions in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Add a new client secret for the application in the Microsoft Entra tenant.
See instructions.
To add a new client secret:
Sign in to the Microsoft Azure portal and go to Microsoft Entra ID.
In the left-side navigation, select App registrations.
See image.
The App registrations page appears.
On the App registrations page, select the Owned applications tab.
Search for and select the application you created while onboarding.
In the left-side navigation, select Certificates & secrets.
See image.
The Certificates & secrets page appears.
On the Certificates & secrets page, under Client secrets tab, click + New client secret.
See image.
The Add a client secret page appears.
On the Add a client secret page:
Description: Enter a description for the client secret.
Expires: Select the expiration date from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Click Add.
In the Client secrets table, under Value, click the Copy icon to copy the string to the clipboard.
See image.
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page appears.
On the Cloud Accounts page, select the subscription for which you want to update the client secret.
Click Manage and then select Change Application Details.
See image.
The Change Application Details window appears.
In the Change Application Details window, for Client Secret, paste the string copied from the Microsoft Entra tenant.
See image.
Click Validate.
DSPM validates the updated client secret by verifying it against the application ID. If the validation is successful, a message appears indicating that the connection is established.
If the client secret is invalid, or it does not match the application, an error is displayed.
Click Done.
The client secret is updated for the application.
